$comment: Place kinds. Every entry with origin otwd is the site_types list of the Open Touring and Waypoint Database (OTWD) vocabulary, version 1.0.0, Apache-2.0. Entries with origin ocdb are Open Camping DB extensions.

kinds.label: Campground
kinds.note: A camp site whose fee is not known. Open Camping DB extension.

kinds.label: Picnic area
kinds.note: A day-use picnic area. Open Camping DB extension.

kinds.label: Farm stay
kinds.note: A station or farm stay: an OSM camp or caravan site named as one, or private land listed by its owner, who must be booked first. Open Camping DB extension.

kinds.label: Backpacker hostel
kinds.note: A hostel with shared rooms or dorms (OSM tourism=hostel). Open Camping DB extension.

kinds.label: Roofed accommodation
kinds.note: Cabins, motels and chalets that are not part of a campground (OSM tourism=motel or tourism=chalet). Hotels and guest houses are left out. Open Camping DB extension.

kinds.label: Long vehicle parking
kinds.note: Parking marked for motorhomes, caravans or heavy vehicles (OSM amenity=parking with motorhome, caravan or hgv=designated). Open Camping DB extension.

kinds.label: Food and drink
kinds.note: A pub (OSM amenity=pub), or a cafe, bakery or restaurant listed by travellers or its owner. OSM cafes and restaurants are left out: there are too many. Open Camping DB extension.

kinds.label: Recreation area
kinds.note: An outdoor area for day use only, with no overnight stays. Listed by travellers or its owner. Open Camping DB extension.

kinds.label: Arts, history and culture
kinds.note: A museum, gallery or heritage site (OSM tourism=museum or tourism=gallery). Open Camping DB extension.

kinds.label: Experience
kinds.note: A paid tour, tasting or activity, listed by travellers or its owner. Open Camping DB extension.
